name: omnirag-eval-v1
description: Phase 12 evaluation set: the 40 seed questions (Phase 3b), the 8 relational questions (Phase 7, typed multi_hop here) and 62 new ones written from data/samples. Evidence is verbatim text (ADR-0009); every quote is checked against the samples by tests. must_include lists the terms a correct answer contains (a list = alternatives), compared after NFKC/case/whitespace normalisation. Relevant chunk IDs are derived from the evidence at run time for the chunk set in use (ADR-0008) and recorded in reports.
